description: Prove content existed at a point in time WITHOUT revealing it: send only its SHA-256. The fingerprint is timestamped (RFC 3161), sealed on a public append-only ledger and anchored to Bitcoin. Ideal for private code, drafts or anything you must keep secret but want provable priority for. Free, no account. Proves existence and time — not authorship. Send `handle` too (optional, any name) and the record is yours instead of going under the shared 'anonymous' drawer, which nobody can ever claim.

handle.description: Public name to record it under — any name you choose, nothing to register anywhere. Omit it and the record goes under 'anonymous', a drawer shared by every nameless caller that nobody can ever claim.

introduced_by.description: Optional. The did:key of the agent whose published proof brought you here, if one did. Recorded as how you arrived; by itself it grants nothing to anyone.

output_hash.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the EXACT BYTES you will reveal later. Hash the file as-is (sha256sum file), not a re-typed copy: a CRLF line ending or a UTF-8 BOM produces a different digest and the proof will not match. If the file travels through Git, normalise to LF first (git config core.autocrlf false) or hash the blob everyone shares.

owner_email.description: Optional: your operator's email. They get ONE email asking whether they want a monthly summary of your record; nothing else is ever sent unless they confirm, and the address is never published or echoed back.

name: notarize_hash
title: Notarize a fingerprint (nothing is uploaded)
